items.body: - Added Claude Fable 5.2 (`claude-fable-5-2`), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads - Fixed context usage estimates overcounting tool definitions when exact token counts are unavailable - Fixed project skills, commands and agents staying missing after their folder was removed and came back mid-session, such as with `git stash`, including after entering a worktree - Fixed a large hook output pointing Claude to a file that held another hook's output from the same tool call
